title: blockmines
description: Minecraft mod which adds explosive mines to your game...
body:
A mod which adds explosive mines to your favorite block-mining game.

For now it only features the claymore and tools to safely defuse the mines, yet in future releases I'd like to implement other explosives too.

The mines explode when a player steps in their reach. Once placed, they are only active when the player leaves the reach area for 3 seconds. Players can safely enter and reset the countdown back only if the mine hasn't made a beep sound indicating it's now active.

Open issues for the favorite explosives you'd like to see in game!
